scope: Dashboard production-bundle budgets with measured vendor/route code splitting and an explicit lazy MapLibre exception contract.

baselineBefore.note: single index chunk pulled DEV catalog icons + eager Server/BotAdmin/ServerSlot

contracts.entryNoDevCatalogIcons: App imports DEV_TOOL_SLUGS (icon-free), not full lucide catalog
contracts.manualChunks: vite manualChunks isolates vendor-react/router/query/socket/lucide/misc and exactly one lazy vendor-radar-map chunk
contracts.normalChunkBudget: entry and every non-MapLibre emitted JS chunk must stay below 500 KiB raw
contracts.radarVendorBudget: exactly one lazy vendor-radar-map chunk may exceed 500 KiB but must stay below 1 MiB raw and 300 KiB gzip
contracts.measureScript: scripts/measure-dashboard-bundle.mjs measures raw + gzip bytes and fails closed on every Stage 56 budget
contracts.buildIntegration: dashboard-ui npm run build executes the Stage 56 measurement; CI/CD, Verification 2 and Playwright therefore enforce it before completion
contracts.exactShaArtifact: .github/workflows/stage56-bundle.yml binds pull-request evidence to pull_request.head.sha and push evidence to github.sha
contracts.gateRule: implementation head must pass CI/CD + Verification 2 + Playwright + Stage 56; merged main must then pass CI/CD + Playwright + Stage 56 again

currentEvidence.note: The merged main build produced the exact-SHA artifact with zero residuals; CI/CD including Docker+Trivy and the main Playwright gate also completed successfully.

previousFailedEvidence.note: Historical evidence under the obsolete blanket <500 KiB all-chunk rule; retained as history and not counted as current proof.

previousEvidence.note: historical pre-MapLibre evidence only; not counted as the current Stage 56 gate
